description: Generate a deterministic procedural texture from a named pattern, size, palette, and seed. Returns PNG bytes and/or the editable .mcpx source via explicit output paths or embedded artifacts; no force, mkdir, or in-place writes.

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

palette.description: Builtin material name or .mcpx path for colors.

pattern.description: Procedural pattern: noise, clustered-noise, stripes, checker, gradient, brick, spots, veins, cracks, or grain.

name: generate_asset
